falseSynonyms.zh: 提供建議不等於協助 advise 表示給意見；assist 可以是實際幫忙，不一定涉及建議。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lawyer advised me what to do. Her assistant helped me complete the form.

falseSynonyms.zh: 陪同不等於協助 accompany 只表示和某人一起去；陪同的人未必有提供幫助。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She accompanied him to the hospital. A nurse assisted him when he arrived.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服務不等於協助 serve 可以表示提供服務，但不一定等於幫某人完成具體事情。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The restaurant serves customers. Staff may also assist customers with special requests.

falseSynonyms.zh: 救援不等於一般協助 rescue 表示從危險中救出，語氣比普通 assist 強得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Firefighters rescued the child. Volunteers assisted the family afterward.

falseSynonyms.zh: 合作不等於幫忙 cooperate 表示一起合作或配合；assist 更強調一方向另一方提供幫助。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The two teams cooperated on the project. One team also assisted the other with testing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 使能夠不等於直接協助 enable 強調提供條件或能力；assist 通常表示實際提供幫助。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The software enables remote work. The technician assists users with technical problems.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與動詞不同 assistant 是協助者；assist 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The assistant answered the phone. She assisted the manager with the report.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與動詞不同 assistance 是名詞；assist 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They offered assistance. They assisted the visitors.
